title: Reading lab: Ephesians 2:1–10
subtitle: Track contrast, grace, and purpose across a paragraph.
overview: Ephesians 2:1–10 is a major A2 Core paragraph: it moves from condition, through divine action, to a purpose statement about a new way of life.
Map the strong δέ contrast, the participial condition, the perfect passive salvation statement, and the final ἵνα clause.

items.grc: αὐτοῦ γάρ ἐσμεν ποίημα, κτισθέντες ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ἐπὶ ἔργοις ἀγαθοῖς.
items.en: For we are his workmanship, having been created in Christ Jesus for good works.
So that we may walk in them.
